header: Which price list applies to you?
subheader: Three rate cards, because a single practice and a rehabilitation centre are not buying the same thing.
lead: Pick the one that describes your organisation. If you are between two of them, take the smaller — moving up later costs nothing and keeps every appointment.
note: All three lists quote net prices in euro for Austria. Practices in Germany are billed in euro on the same figures; other countries are quoted individually.

routes.title: A single practice
routes.description: One to fifteen practitioners at up to three addresses. Published prices, monthly billing, no minimum term.

routes.title: A group or institution
routes.description: More than fifteen practitioners, or a procurement process with its own requirements. Written offer, fixed for the term.

routes.title: A teaching institution
routes.description: Universities of applied sciences and training providers using Talbrunn in class with sample data only.
